quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway, the approach for the left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof, and the turn must be made by turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.

activation.condition: Driver intends a left turn at an intersection from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway.

obligation.description: Approach in the right half nearest the centerline, enter from its right, and turn as close as practicable to the one-way highway left curb.

timing.description: Approach, intersection entry, and departure phases.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original full-body approach distance from the centerline; the statute supplies no numeric nearest cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original body distance from the departure left curb and retain roadway feasibility; the statute supplies no numeric practicability cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: turn_variant
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: centerline approach/left-curb departure, farther approach, or farther departure engineering commands; observed body position remains measured
